paper.title: Adversarial Attacks on Gaussian Process Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Targeted adversarial attacks on GP bandits (corrupted GP bandit setup of Bogunovic et al. 2020, attacker's perspective)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Guarantees are for the attacker (budget needed to force a non-robust GP bandit algorithm into a target region), not for the learner.
unmapped: Objective of the attacker: force T(1-o(1)) plays in a target region R_target using small corruption budget
Attacker observes x_t and (for white-box attacks) knows f
Learner algorithm is deterministic (GP-UCB or MaxVar+Elimination) and non-robust
settings.definition_quote: The player seeks to maximize an unknown function $f(\xv)$ over $\xv \in D$, and we model the smoothness of $f$ by assuming that it has RKHS norm at most $B$ ... we consider corrupted observations taking the form $y_t = f(\xv_t) + c_t + z_t$, where $z_t \sim \N(0,\sigma^2)$ ... we constrain $\sum_{t=1}^n |c_t| \le C$

algorithms.name: Function-shifting targeted attack (f -> f tilde; e.g. Subtraction / Aggressive Subtraction attack)

symbols.N_0: number of Delta-suboptimal actions the uncorrupted algorithm plays w.p. >= 1-delta, depending on (T, Delta, delta)

conditions: every Delta-optimal point of f tilde lies in R_target and has f tilde = f
|f(x) - f tilde(x)| <= B_0 for all x
learner algorithm plays at most N_0 Delta-suboptimal actions w.p. >= 1-delta absent adversary

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Then, in the presence of the adversary, with probability at least $1-\delta$, the attack succeeds in forcing $T(1-o(1))$ actions to be played from $\targetr$, while using an attack budget $C$ of at most $B_0 N_0$.

results.notes: Bound is on the attack budget used (attacker guarantee), while forcing T(1-o(1)) plays in target region; applies to any learner with the stated non-robust guarantee.

symbols.N_max: max{N : N <= C_1 gamma_N beta_T / Delta^2}, C_1 = 8/lambda / log(1+1/lambda)
symbols.Delta: suboptimality margin of f tilde outside target region (not an arm gap)

conditions: learner is GP-UCB with beta_t from Chowdhury & Gopalan

source.label: cor:main
source.quote: the attack succeeds in forcing $T(1-o(1))$ actions to be played from $\targetr$ against GP-UCB (respectively, the elimination algorithm) using an attack budget $C$ of at most $B_0 N_{\max}(\Delta,T)$ (respectively, $B_0 N'_{\max}(\Delta)$)

symbols.N_max_prime: max{N : N <= 4 C_1 gamma_N beta_N / Delta^2}
symbols.Delta: suboptimality margin of f tilde outside target region

source.label: cor:main
source.quote: using an attack budget $C$ of at most $B_0 N_{\max}(\Delta,T)$ (respectively, $B_0 N'_{\max}(\Delta)$)

results.notes: Attack budget against the elimination algorithm; independent of T.

cited_results.setting_description: Uncorrupted GP bandit, RKHS norm B; number of Delta-suboptimal actions in T rounds, w.p. >= 1-delta
